title: 🤔 Puzzle game

messages.content: Explain the Chain-of-Thoughts behind solving the Game of Symbols

[Olli | System Spokesperson] 

The Game of Symbols is a logic puzzle that requires arranging four symbols (A, B, C, and D) in a specific order to achieve the best possible performance. Each symbol has unique performance characteristics:

1. A yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol.
2. B yields best performance if not preceded by symbol A or C.
3. C yields best performance unless it is the last symbol.
4. D yields best performance when being the first symbol.

To solve the game, start by placing symbol D first, as it yields the best performance when it is the first symbol. Then, avoid following symbol A with more than one symbol, leaving the arrangement: D - C - A - B. This sequence satisfies all the constraints, making it the optimal solution.

By following this chain of thoughts, you can solve the Game of Symbols for any set of constraints. The key is to analyze the relationships between the symbols and apply them systematically to find the correct order.
